info.name: OpenBuild ⇄ NL Design Theme Asset Contract
info.description:
Newman/Postman contract suite for the nldesign-theme-selection feature (REQ-NTS-002/006/008, theme-picker-consumes-nldesign). OpenBuild is a pure read-only consumer (ADR-022) of nldesign's real, published, non-admin surface — it adds NO PHP. This collection pins exactly what OpenBuild's dependency chain reads so nldesign-side drift fails CI:

  1. GET <static>/apps/nldesign/css/tokens/rijkshuisstijl.css — the token asset `@conduction/nextcloud-vue`'s `useScopedTheme().apply()` fetches INTERNALLY (OpenBuild's own code never calls this directly, REQ-NTS-006). Asserts 200, a text/css-ish content type, a `:root` rule, and the `--nldesign-color-primary` variable the applier scopes.
  2. GET /apps/nldesign/api/token-sets as a NON-ADMIN session — the real endpoint `useScopedTheme().listTokenSets()` wraps (`app-token-set-selection`, `#[NoAdminRequired]`). Asserts 200 + `{ tokenSets: [...] }` reachable WITHOUT an admin session, replacing the old '403 as non-admin — flagged dependency' assertion this collection carried before that endpoint existed.
  3. POST /apps/nldesign/api/contrast/evaluate — the real endpoint `useScopedTheme().evaluateContrast()` wraps. Asserts 200 + a `{ results: [...] }` diagnostic shape (ratio/level/pass facts), consistent with REQ-NTS-008: warn-only, no verdict/blocked field fabricated by either side.

AUTH MODEL mirrors the other openbuild collections: noauth collection auth + explicit basic-auth per request; the non-admin request uses the `viewerUser`/`viewerPass` variables (set to a non-admin account in CI) and targets the 127.0.0.1 host so the admin session cookie is host-scoped away from it. With no non-admin account configured the non-admin probe asserts 401 (unauthenticated), which nldesign's `#[NoAdminRequired]` route still tolerates as a valid 'no session at all' outcome distinct from 403 admin-only rejection.

The collection is tolerant of a stock instance: the asset request always asserts; the token-sets/contrast requests assert their shape only when 200 (an empty/!installed nldesign skips with a note, never faking a pass). Run via run-newman.sh.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 404) { pm.test('skipped — nldesign / rijkshuisstijl asset not present on this instance', () => pm.expect(true).to.be.true); return; }
pm.test('token asset returns 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const ct = pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '';
pm.test('content type is css-ish', () => pm.expect(ct.toLowerCase()).to.match(/css|text/));
const body = pm.response.text();
pm.test('asset contains a :root rule', () => pm.expect(body).to.include(':root'));
pm.test('asset defines --nldesign-color-primary (the variable the applier scopes)', () => pm.expect(body).to.include('--nldesign-color-primary'));

item.name: 2. token-sets as NON-ADMIN (200 + { tokenSets: [...] } containing rijkshuisstijl, when reachable)

exec: if (pm.response.code === 401) { pm.test('skipped — no non-admin account configured, unauthenticated request denied (still not the old 403-as-non-admin outcome)', () => pm.expect(true).to.be.true); return; }
if (pm.response.code !== 200) { pm.test('token-sets endpoint not reachable on this instance — skipped (status ' + pm.response.code + ')', () => pm.expect(true).to.be.true); return; }
let body; try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { body = null; }
pm.test('response is { tokenSets: [...] }', () => pm.expect(body && Array.isArray(body.tokenSets)).to.be.true);
if (body && Array.isArray(body.tokenSets)) {
pm.test('a NON-ADMIN session can list token sets — the flagged REQ-NTS-006 dependency is resolved', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200));
const ids = body.tokenSets.map((s) => s.id);
if (ids.length) { pm.test('list entries carry theming swatches', () => pm.expect(body.tokenSets[0]).to.have.property('theming')); }
pm.test('list contains rijkshuisstijl (when the fixture set is installed)', () => { if (ids.length) pm.expect(ids).to.include('rijkshuisstijl'); });

item.name: 3. contrast/evaluate shape (200 + { results: [...] } diagnostic, no verdict field)

exec: if (pm.response.code === 401) { pm.test('skipped — no non-admin account configured', () => pm.expect(true).to.be.true); return; }
if (pm.response.code !== 200) { pm.test('contrast/evaluate endpoint not reachable on this instance — skipped (status ' + pm.response.code + ')', () => pm.expect(true).to.be.true); return; }
let body; try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { body = null; }
pm.test('response is { results: [...] }', () => pm.expect(body && Array.isArray(body.results)).to.be.true);
pm.test('REQ-NTS-008: no fabricated verdict/blocked field on the collection root', () => { pm.expect(body).to.not.have.property('verdict'); pm.expect(body).to.not.have.property('blocked'); });
